domestic.debt_note: Finance Division's 1HFY26 Debt Bulletin reports domestic debt at PKR55,363bn at Dec-25, up 1.6%; first-half gross domestic issuance was PKR14,377bn and 95% of the federal fiscal deficit was financed domestically. The exact July-26 domestic-debt stock was not independently retrievable in this run.
domestic.remittances: SBP reported workers' remittances of US$3.7bn in August 2026, up 16.5% YoY and 0.7% MoM; Jul-Aug FY27 inflows were US$7.3bn, up 14.7% YoY.
domestic.current_account: Finance Division reported a US$328m current-account deficit for July 2026. August 2026 balance-of-payments data was scheduled by SBP for release no later than September 16, so the August balance is unverified.

global_read: Global tape remains risk-off for PSX: Brent $108.97 (+4.17% 1d, +23.1% 1mo), WTI $104.24 (+4.19% 1d, +26.5% 1mo), VIX 17.75 (+12.06% 1d), and USD/PKR +2.98% 1d, while S&P 500 and Dow remain negative over one month.
drivers: SBP displays the policy rate at 11.50%; its FY27 calendar lists the September 14, 2026 MPC meeting and October 26, 2026 as the next scheduled meeting. The September statement was not independently retrievable in this run. Source: https://www.sbp.org.pk/our-operations/monetary-policy

PBS reported August 2026 CPI inflation at 11.1% YoY versus 9.2% in July; urban and rural core inflation were 8.8% and 8.5%, respectively. Source: https://www.pbs.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/Monthly-Review-August-2026.pdf

SBP's current economic-data page reports total liquid FX reserves of $23.7158bn as of September 4, 2026, with $18.3282bn held by SBP and $5.3876bn by banks. Source: https://www.sbp.org.pk/stats/stat-bal-sheet.htm
SBP's latest displayed auction cutoffs are 11.899% for the 6-month MTB and 12.300% for the 10-year fixed PIB. Source: https://www.sbp.org.pk/stats/stat-bal-sheet.htm

The IMF completed Pakistan's third EFF review and second RSF review on May 8, 2026, allowing about $1.1bn under EFF and $220m under RSF; the IMF schedule lists September 15, 2026 for the fourth EFF review. Sources: https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2026/05/08/pr-26147-pakistan-imf-completes-3rd-rev-of-extended-arrangement-under-eff-and-2nd-rev-arrang-rsf and https://www.elibrary.imf.org/view/journals/002/2026/101/article-A001-en.xml

Finance Division reported FY2026 fiscal deficit at 2.6% of GDP and primary surplus at 2.9% of GDP; July 2026 current-account deficit was $328m. Source: https://www.finance.gov.pk/economic/Monthly_Economic_Update_and_Outlook_August_2026.pdf

Finance Division's 1HFY26 Debt Bulletin reports domestic debt of PKR55,363bn at December 2025, first-half gross issuance of PKR14,377bn, and 95% of the federal fiscal deficit financed from domestic sources. Source: https://www.finance.gov.pk/dpco/debt_bulletin_1hy_2026.pdf

SBP reported August 2026 workers' remittances of $3.7bn, up 16.5% YoY, and Jul-Aug FY27 inflows of $7.3bn, up 14.7% YoY. Source: https://www.sbp.org.pk/assets/documents/press-release/PR-09-September-2026.pdf
SBP's data calendar places the August 2026 balance-of-payments summary no later than September 16, 2026. Source: https://www.sbp.org.pk/data-calendar

next_events.event: SBP analyst briefing for the September 14 MPC; IMF fourth EFF review availability date.
SBP scheduled release deadline for August 2026 balance-of-payments data.
